However, I was unable to cancel order 305 because it is already in 'Complete' status with both items marked as 'Refunded'. The order was placed on April 19, 2023, has been partially refunded ($10.00 out of $91.00 total), and a credit memo (#100000011) already exists. In Magento's order management system, completed orders that have been invoiced, shipped, and partially refunded cannot be canceled. The system only allows cancellation of pending or processing orders. The order details page shows no 'Cancel' option, and the status dropdown only offers 'Complete' as the available status. Therefore, order 305 cannot be canceled through the standard Magento admin interface.
